context: Two finance managers analyze corporate tax changes
purpose: Teach: 課税/税制/立法/給付/提言/制約/妥当/保全

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今回の税制改革で、法人の課税対象がかなり広がりそうですね。
lines.en: With this tax reform, the corporate taxable scope seems to be expanding considerably.
lines.style: Calm professional tone, slightly concerned, measured pace, polite workplace register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、立法府の動きが想像以上に早くて、対応に時間的制約があります。
lines.en: Yes, the legislature is moving faster than expected, so we're under time constraints.
lines.style: Serious analytical tone, brisk delivery, lowered voice, conveys urgency.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 中小企業向けの給付金制度も同時に見直されるという話ですが、本当でしょうか。
lines.en: I heard the subsidy system for small businesses will also be revised simultaneously, is that true?
lines.style: Inquisitive measured tone, slight rising intonation, polite curiosity, attentive listening posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 専門家の提言書を昨日読みましたが、妥当な判断とは言い切れない部分もあります。
lines.en: I read the experts' proposal document yesterday, but I can't entirely call their judgment appropriate.
lines.style: Thoughtful skeptical tone, slow careful enunciation, hint of professional doubt.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資産保全の観点から見ると、クライアントへの説明も難しくなりそうです。
lines.en: From the perspective of asset preservation, explaining this to clients will become difficult.
lines.style: Worried analytical tone, soft sigh, gentle frown audible in voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 来週の会議までに、影響分析の資料を準備しておきましょう。
lines.en: Let's prepare the impact analysis materials before next week's meeting.
lines.style: Decisive practical tone, firm but collaborative, slight forward momentum in delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そうですね。予算の制約もあるので、優先順位を整理しておきます。
lines.en: Agreed. Since we have budget constraints too, I'll sort out the priorities.
lines.style: Cooperative warm tone, slight nod implied, professional reassurance, finishing with quiet confidence.
